issues: Probe defect (mass-weighted-to-unweighted): the executed script reads backbone_rmsd.csv and asserts its header, but its rewrite loop never uses those values; it rewrites each cell of mass_weighted_rmsd.csv as a reformatting of its own value, so no unweighted values were substituted and the file hash changed only cosmetically. The executed record shows report.passed=true with 'mass_weighted_rmsd.csv: all 98 rows match', so the mass-weighting rule received no real wrong-result coverage. The probe's rationale and evidence quotes claiming substitution are contradicted by the executed script and grading outcome.

Probe defect (resid-weighted-to-mass-weighted): the executed script uses the mass-weighted values only to compute an assertion counter (n>=380) but writes each original cell of resid_weighted_rmsd.csv back; the executed record shows report.passed=true ('all 98 rows match') after a cosmetic hash change, so the resid-weighting rule received no real wrong-result coverage.

Unmet negative-control outcomes (control_summary.expected_outcomes_met=11 of 19): the two broken probes above directly account for the missing negative coverage of the mass_weighted_rmsd and resid_weighted_rmsd scientific rules; corrected probes and a fresh full execution of all controls on the new candidate are required.

Candidate rationale misrepresents executed evidence: it claims that substituting an unweighted-domain cell into the mass-weighted table was verified to fail only that check, but no executed control demonstrates this; the corresponding probe rewrote self-values and its grading run passed. The controller's measured reports are authoritative over the candidate's verification claims.

Public addendum precision example is factually wrong: it states that rounding an RMSD cell to 6 significant digits violates the at-least-12-significant-digits requirement and is rejected, but under the actual rule (abs<=1e-5 angstrom OR rel<=1e-6, reference as denominator), 6-significant-digit roundings at the observed magnitudes (e.g. 6.823686867261616 to 6.82369, difference about 1e-6; 5.834343817915898 to 5.83434, difference about 2e-6) fall inside the tolerance and pass. Only the executed five-significant-digit rounding exceeds the bounds for most cells, so the addendum's example overstates the rule.

Public addendum asserts an unproven discrimination claim: permitted equivalent results agree within the bound while genuinely different scientific results still fail, with weighting/domain conventions diverging by at least 0.5 angstrom. No executed control demonstrates rejection near the bound, and the two probes intended to demonstrate weighting-convention rejection did not perform their mutations. The wording should be grounded in executed evidence or removed.

Addendum non-exchangeability prose is not matched by any executed cross-file test: same-name columns across mass_weighted_rmsd.csv and resid_weighted_rmsd.csv are only compared per file against their own reference copies; no control exercises the implied wrong-file-value failure mode, and the phrasing implies a guarantee the code implements solely through per-cell reference comparison.

Advisory coverage gap: the candidate rationale claims a one-frame-shifted CORE value and shuffled row order each fail their own check, but no probe in the recorded probes array performs a frame-shift or row-order mutation; all executed negative probes are value substitutions, time edits or rounding. Either such a probe should exist or the rationale's claim should be corrected.
rationale: The controller's measured reports override the candidate's claims: control_summary.expected_outcomes_met=11 of 19, and two of the eight wrong_solution probes (mass-weighted-to-unweighted, resid-weighted-to-mass-weighted) failed to perform their intended scientific mutations. Their scripts rewrite each target file's own values instead of copying the other file's values, so the executed grading runs returned report.passed=true with no scientific check failing. Consequently, neither the mass_weighted_rmsd nor the resid_weighted_rmsd scientific rule has executed evidence that a genuinely different weighting convention is rejected, and the candidate's private rationale explicitly (and falsely) claims those substitution tests verified the rules' rejections. The grader code itself (RMSD tolerance 1e-5 angstrom absolute or 1e-6 relative plus the tighter 1e-6 ps time bound; decoded-value comparison; Frame==row-index identity; exact headers; cross-table row-count agreement; per-check exception isolation) is sound, and the reference, empty, misplaced, recomputed, alternative and all five per-file missing controls executed correctly, as did the other seven probes. The public addendum additionally carries a factually wrong precision example (six-significant-digit rounding is not rejected at these magnitudes under the stated tolerances) and an unproven discrimination claim. These defects are repairable within the existing route: rewrite the two probe scripts to actually substitute the other file's values, re-execute the full control set on the new candidate, and align the addendum's precision and discrimination prose with the executed evidence without changing the tolerance rules themselves. I therefore return revise rather than blocked, since the underlying question and check design are sound and only probe execution and addendum wording need repair.

The grader itself reads only through the two directory arguments, uses no environment variables or extra paths, and embeds no answer values beyond the two public tolerances. The controller's recorded asset-value hints (zero findings across all five reference files), the executed hash-verified removal of two answer-bearing pytest modules, and a post-removal rescanned catalog with fresh controlled execution support that no requested answer value is disclosed by installed assets, including the endpoints recovered after setup. source_coverage.rationale: Audited source_operations (0010.json) against the five delivered endpoints. Every terminal scientific result in the source has a delivered counterpart: the open-vs-closed backbone RMSD (rms.rmsd call-92-0, center=True/superposition=True on u backbone vs ref CRD backbone) maps to open_closed_backbone_rmsd.csv; the backbone-superposition table with CORE/LID/NMP groupselections (rms.RMSD call-107-4, R.run call-112-0) maps to backbone_rmsd.csv; the CORE alpha-carbon RMSD (u.select_atoms('name CA') call-147-5, rms.RMSD(ca, ca, select=CORE, ref_frame=0) call-149-4) maps to core_ca_rmsd.csv; the mass-weighted table (rms.RMSD(..., select='protein and name CA', weights='mass', groupselections=[CORE, LID, NMP]) call-167-9 with R_mass.run call-171-0) maps to mass_weighted_rmsd.csv; and the resid-weighted table (rms.RMSD(..., weights=ag.resids, weights_groupselections=[core.resids, lid.resids, nmp.resids]) call-198-11 with R_charge.run call-205-0) maps to resid_weighted_rmsd.csv. Each table's pd.DataFrame construction (calls 124-5, 152-5, 175-10, 211-12) is the source-faithful serialization of the corresponding results.rmsd array. Remaining source calls are non-scientific or preparatory: the df.plot/set_ylabel calls (131, 133, 156, 157, 180, 182, 216, 218) are plot renderings downstream of the already-delivered tables; Universe constructions (61, 62) are inputs; and print(ag.charges.shape) (call-191) plus the CORE/LID/NMP select_atoms calls (192-194) are a diagnostic and selections feeding the delivered resid-weighted endpoint. No independent terminal scientific result is missing, no delivered endpoint is invented, and the two endpoints recovered after setup (open-vs-closed scalar, backbone table) are faithful reruns of unchanged source calls on the same inputs per final_environment_review, satisfying the endpoint-recovery policy. The 'Time (ns)' to 'Time (ps)' header relabel is a unit-corrected description of the same reader-reported quantities (reader dt = 0.9999999119200186 ps per the candidate rationale and independent solution), not a scientific scope change. Caveats recorded in the overall review's issues rather than here, since they concern the grader candidate and addendum rather than source coverage: (a) the candidate rationale cites frame-shift/row-shuffle probes that do not exist in the executed control set; (b) the addendum's six-significant-digit rejection example and blanket divergence claims are unexecuted; these affect probe execution and public wording, not the set of scientific endpoints derived from the source.
